name: Beacon Office Building

notes: NAMED FROM THE CITY FILING, which is a deliberate choice between two candidates. The City of Miami waiver log carries case PZ-22-14378-WA titled Beacon Office Building at 2871 OAK AV — an exact address match in a primary government record, and city filings are an acceptable source for a name. The building is MARKETED today as the Vizcaya Capital Building, but that name appears only on broker and listing sites, which are excluded. Commercial Observer confirms the project at the right address, giving a five-storey, 34,856 sq ft office by Vizcaya Capital with Arquitectonica designing and a $25.2m City National construction loan, but never names the building. So the filing name is stored and the marketed name recorded here; a reader who prefers the marketed form should change it by hand. Owner of record for folio 0141210160730 is 2871 OAK LLC. A Bisnow piece using the marketed name was checked and ruled out — it concerns 3250 Mary Street, a different asset.
